data.name: Afroj
data.gender_notes: Afroj is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aparna', meaning 'without leaves' or 'celestial'. Afroj represents the grace of the gods bestowed upon an individual. The name Afroj carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Mythological tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Afroj usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with divine blessings.
data.etymology: Afroj belongs to the Mythological linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afroj total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
